Edit Image1 into a DUO ability card in this same illustrated set. Image2 is the additional approved style reference. Completely replace the original missile motif with the combined ability described below. Preserve the exact COARSE MATTE GOUACHE style: broad flat brush strokes, dry ink edges, rough pigment texture, few simple shading tones and atmospheric painted stone arches/warm amber depth. Square full-bleed with one clear large central interaction inside70%, quiet lower edge. Abilities visibly interact in one action, rather than separate icon stickers. No labels, text, digits, card borders, evil background enemies, HD/photorealistic rendering, glossy detail, bokeh, filigree, neon or excessive sparks.
BULWARK ENGINE combines Reflect Shield and Stamina Core: a round pale-blue mirrored ward catches a single projectile and bends its trail back. From the small ivory parry impact, a restrained warm amber ribbon feeds into a protected core of ivory ribs at the center of the ward, rekindling its life pulse. The return strike visibly restores the heart's protection. No physical furnace/machine or armored character.
